signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use your platform account.
signIn.failed: That username and password did not match an account.

pitch.title: One account for every cvhome app.
pitch.copy: Sign in once to reach the seller console and the services behind it.

notice.noSearch: uaa matches accounts on metadata equality and offers no text search, so this list is not filtered.

empty.title: No accounts
empty.message: uaa has no accounts registered yet.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.message: Choose a new password for {{name}}. They will not be asked to change it at next sign-in.
reset.hint: At least twelve characters, mixing letters, digits and symbols.
reset.handoverHint: You will not be able to read this again — hand it over before you close the dialog.
reset.weak: That password is too easy to guess.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

roles.empty: uaa offers no roles this account may be given.

delete.title: Delete this account
delete.message: {{name}} will be removed from uaa. There is no undo and no soft delete.

detail.readOnlyNote: uaa does not allow either to be changed here.
detail.createHint: uaa stores the account without a password — you will set one next.
detail.usernameHint: What the account signs in with. It cannot be changed afterwards.
detail.enabledHint: A disabled account keeps its roles and cannot sign in.
detail.metadataHint: uaa merges metadata on save, so a key that is already stored cannot be removed here — only edited, or joined by a new one.
detail.metadataLocked: Stored keys cannot be removed through uaa's update.

notice.rename: Renaming a role does not re-issue anyone's token: whoever is signed in keeps the old authority until they sign in again.

empty.title: No roles
empty.message: uaa has no roles registered yet.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: The authority string itself. Services match on it exactly.
form.description: A role is a name. What it grants is decided by each service, not stored here.

delete.title: Delete this role
delete.message: {{name}} will be removed, and every account holding it loses that authority.
delete.confirmationLabel: Type the role name to confirm

clients.title: OAuth2 clients
clients.context: The applications that authenticate against uaa

notice.secret: uaa never returns a client secret. The only moment you can read one is the moment you set it — copy it before you close the dialog.

empty.title: No clients
empty.message: No applications are registered against uaa yet.

rotate.title: Set a new secret
rotate.message: Choose a new secret for {{clientId}}. The old one stops working immediately.
rotate.hint: At least twenty characters. Treat it like a password.
rotate.handoverHint: uaa will not show this again — copy it into the application's configuration now.
rotate.weak: That secret is too easy to guess.
rotate.mismatch: The two secrets do not match.

delete.title: Delete this client
delete.message: {{clientId}} will be removed, and any application using it can no longer obtain a token.
delete.confirmationLabel: Type the client id to confirm

toast.secretRotated: A new secret was set for {{clientId}}.

clientForm.context: What the application is allowed to ask uaa for
clientForm.invalid: Some settings still need attention — see the checklist.
clientForm.clientIdHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, at least three characters. Changing it breaks every integration already using it.
clientForm.redirectEmpty: Required when authorization_code is one of the grant types.
clientForm.logoutEmpty: Optional. Where uaa may send the browser after a sign-out.
clientForm.requireProofKeyHint: Mandatory for a public client, which is one that holds no secret.
clientForm.requireConsentHint: The user approves the requested scopes the first time they sign in.
clientForm.jwkSetUrlHint: Where uaa fetches the client’s public keys. Needed for private_key_jwt.
clientForm.tokenEndpointAlgHint: How the client signs its assertion at the token endpoint.
clientForm.subjectDnHint: The certificate uaa expects for tls_client_auth.
clientForm.authorizationCodeTtlHint: How long a code stays redeemable. Short by design.
clientForm.deviceCodeTtlHint: How long a device-flow code stays valid.
clientForm.ttlHint: Leave the amount empty for uaa’s default.
clientForm.reuseRefreshTokensHint: Off rotates the refresh token on every use, which is the safer choice.
clientForm.certificateBoundHint: Binds a token to the client’s mTLS certificate.
clientForm.accessTokenFormatHint: Self-contained tokens are readable by any service holding the key; reference tokens are not.

check.clientId: Client id set, and in the accepted shape
check.redirectRequired: A redirect URI, which authorization_code needs
check.redirectOptional: No redirect URI needed for these grant types
check.pkceRequired: PKCE is on, which a public client requires
check.pkceOptional: PKCE optional for a client that holds a secret
check.jwkSetUrl: JWK Set URL, where private_key_jwt needs one
check.subjectDn: Subject DN, where tls_client_auth needs one

uri.invalid: Enter an absolute URI, including its scheme.
uri.insecure: Plain HTTP to a remote host — anything on the network path can read the code delivered here.
